title: Cepharanthine protects against lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury in mice by blocking NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
authors: Wang, Bingsi; Dang, Longjiao; Yang, Junjie; Yuan, Zhizhao; He, Biyao; Liu, Jiayu; Wang, Ziyi; Nie, Dan; Gong, Lin; Hou, Guige; Xin, Wenyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Cepharanthine对急性肺损伤的保护作用，涉及NLRP3蛋白与药物小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系完全无关。
abstract: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a common life-threatening lung disease with high mortality and is mostly related to acute inflammatory responses in the lungs. Cepharanthine (CEP), a natural compound extracted from Stefania's genus, has anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, whether CEP has a protective effect on ALI and its potential mechanism of action are unclear. This study investigated the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of CEP on LPS-induced ALI in mice and related cellular models. CEP alleviated pulmonary inflammation in ALI mice, significantly reducing TNF-alpha and IL-1beta levels in the serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF). CEP inhibited LPS-induced inflammatory responses in MH-S macrophages, as evidenced by reduced proinflammatory cytokine secretion and downregulated NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling. Mechanistically, CEP suppressed the activation of the NF-kappaB/NLRP3 inflammasome pathway both in vivo and in vitro. Furthermore, CEP attenuated LPS-induced MLE-12 apoptosis, decreasing the expression of apoptosis-related proteins. The protective effects on MLE-12 cells were associated with the inhibition of the NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway. Molecular docking and SPR studies indicated that CEP potentially binds to NLRP3, suggesting a direct interaction. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that CEP mitigates ALI by modulating NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling, suppressing inflammation, and reducing apoptosis, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic candidate for ALI.
abstract_zh: 急性肺损伤（ALI）是一种常见的危及生命的肺部疾病，死亡率高，主要与肺部的急性炎症反应相关。千金藤素（CEP），一种从千金藤属植物中提取的天然化合物，具有抗炎和抗氧化特性。然而，CEP是否对ALI具有保护作用及其潜在作用机制尚不清楚。本研究探讨了CEP对LPS诱导的小鼠ALI及相关细胞模型的治疗效果和机制。CEP减轻了ALI小鼠的肺部炎症，显著降低了血清和支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）中TNF-alpha和IL-1beta的水平。CEP抑制了LPS诱导的MH-S巨噬细胞炎症反应，表现为促炎细胞因子分泌减少和NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号下调。机制上，CEP在体内和体外均抑制了NF-kappaB/NLRP3炎症小体通路的激活。此外，CEP减弱了LPS诱导的MLE-12细胞凋亡，降低了凋亡相关蛋白的表达。对MLE-12细胞的保护作用与NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路的抑制相关。分子对接和SPR研究表明，CEP可能结合NLRP3，提示存在直接相互作用。综合来看，这些发现表明CEP通过调节NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号、抑制炎症和减少凋亡来缓解ALI，凸显其作为ALI治疗候选药物的潜力。
